notes: Original acquisition not repeated because texts/32fd76ba5dde685e762284a3.miss is explicitly terminal and records unsuccessful DOI, Unpaywall, OpenAlex and primary-paper routes. Replication full-text title and DOI verified against the supplied reference. The locator does not specify a rinse subgroup or one of the four individual OSPAN measures: extracted the authors’ designated primary OSPAN component outcome and pooled main effect of effort. This is a conceptual replication using two initial tasks plus a rinse manipulation; no reverse-digit-span or response-inhibition outcome is reported. The effort main effect is modified by a significant effort-by-rinse interaction; subgroup tests are separate and were not combined. The reported d is preserved as printed, with no conversion; the paired p bound is the significance marker for the same main effect in Table 1.
